name: io.github.sekera-radim/impri
title: Airlock
description: Airlock MCP server — human-in-the-loop approval inbox for AI agents

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Airlock API key as a Bearer token. Get one at airlock.dev.

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOCK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Airlock API key (im_...). Get one at airlock.dev or from your self-hosted server's first-run logs.

environmentVariables.name: AIRLOCK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted Airlock server (e.g. http://localhost:8484). Defaults to the hosted cloud.
